preconditions.expression: 1 <= int(q_line.strip()) <= 10**5 and isinstance(q_line, str) and q_line.strip() != ''
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 10^5) representing the number of operations.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) in {2, 3} for line in operations) and all(line.strip() != '' for line in operations)
preconditions.description: Each of the q subsequent lines is a valid operation line with exactly 2 or 3 space-separated tokens (operation type and either 1 or 2 arguments).

preconditions.expression: all(op in {'set', 'remove', 'query', 'undo'} for op in [line.split()[0] for line in operations])
preconditions.description: Each operation is one of 'set', 'remove', 'query', or 'undo'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(ai) <= 15 and ai.islower() and ai.isalpha() for line in operations if (op := line.split()[0]) in {'set', 'remove', 'query'} and (ai := line.split()[1]))
preconditions.description: Each assignment name ai is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters with length between 1 and 15.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(xi) <= 10**9 for line in operations if (op := line.split()[0]) == 'set' and (xi := line.split()[2]))
preconditions.description: Each priority xi in a 'set' operation is an integer between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(di) < i for i, line in enumerate(operations, 1) if (op := line.split()[0]) == 'undo' and (di := line.split()[1]))
preconditions.description: Each undo operation's di is a non-negative integer less than the current day index i (0 ≤ di < i).
The last operation is always a 'query'.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == '-1' or (0 <= int(stdout_line.strip()) <= len(current_assignments)) for stdout_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: For each 'query' operation, the output is either -1 (if the queried assignment is not in the current to-do list) or a non-negative integer representing the count of assignments with strictly smaller priority values than the queried assignment.

postconditions.expression: all((op := line.split()[0]) == 'query' and (ai := line.split()[1]) in current_assignments and (count := sum(1 for x in current_assignments.values() if x < current_assignments[ai])) == int(stdout_line.strip()) for line, stdout_line in zip(operations, output_lines) if op == 'query')
postconditions.description: For each 'query' operation, if the queried assignment ai is present in the current to-do list, the output is the exact count of assignments with strictly smaller priority values than ai's priority.

postconditions.expression: all((op := line.split()[0]) == 'set' and (ai := line.split()[1]) and (xi := line.split()[2]) and (ai in current_assignments or ai not in previous_assignments) for line in operations if op == 'set')
postconditions.description: After a 'set' operation, the assignment ai is either newly added to the to-do list or its priority is updated to xi, and no other assignments are affected.

postconditions.expression: all((op := line.split()[0]) == 'remove' and (ai := line.split()[1]) and (ai in previous_assignments and ai not in current_assignments or ai not in previous_assignments) for line in operations if op == 'remove')
postconditions.description: After a 'remove' operation, the assignment ai is removed from the to-do list if it was present before the operation, and no other assignments are affected.

postconditions.expression: all((op := line.split()[0]) == 'undo' and (di := line.split()[1]) and (current_assignments == previous_assignments_at_day(int(di))) for line in operations if op == 'undo')
postconditions.description: After an 'undo' operation with di, the to-do list reverts to the state it was in di days prior to the current day (i.e., the state after the operation on day i - di - 1).

invariants.expression: all(ai in current_assignments or ai not in current_assignments for ai in all_assignments_ever_seen)
invariants.description: The to-do list always contains only assignments that have been explicitly added via 'set' operations and not removed or undone.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= current_assignments[ai] <= 10**9 for ai in current_assignments)
invariants.description: Every assignment in the to-do list has a priority value between 1 and 10^9.
